description: This file defines an Android activity called SpeedPickerActivity which displays a list of speed options for the user to select as a speed limit. It uses Wearable-specific UI components and adapts the list with a custom adapter. When a speed is selected, it creates an intent with the new speed limit as an extra and returns that as the result.

classes.name: SpeedPickerActivity
classes.description: An activity that presents a list of speeds to the user and allows the user to pick one to set it as the current speed limit.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, list adapter, and scroll listener.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the click event on a list item, retrieves the selected speed, and sets up the intent result.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: No specific action; placeholder for clicking on empty list area.
